_note: v2 hooks for le Chemin des Gestes (ST_poignees, S02_home), a cobbled lane under cherry trees in spring blossom between lawns and low stone walls with an old street lamp, the gestures street (ST_control seg001-004). Every hook describes what is actually painted (nothing is written in the paintings): Monsieur Verbe the striped mime acts out each verb; the hand mirror marks the reflexive verbs; beret colour = verb group.

fr_trembler_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe TREMBLES like a jelly as a fat bumblebee buzzes past his nose (tron-BLAY).
fr_trembler_verb.why: TREMBLE → trembler = to tremble, to shake (il tremble de peur). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_agiter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe AGITATES his snow globe until the snow swirls (a-zhee-TAY).
fr_agiter_verb.why: AGITATE → agiter = to shake, to wave, to stir up (agiter le flacon). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_secouer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe shakes the cherry tree so hard that a SQUAWKING magpie flaps away (suh-KWAY).
fr_secouer_verb.why: SQUAWK → secouer = to shake (secouer un arbre, secouer la tête). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_pencher_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe leans far over the wall to catch blossom in his frying PAN (pon-SHAY).
fr_pencher_verb.why: PAN → pencher = to lean, to tilt (se pencher par la fenêtre). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_tendre_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe holds out a TENDER little pink cupcake to the girl (TONdr).
fr_tendre_verb.why: TENDER → tendre = to hold out, to stretch out (tendre la main); also an adjective, tender. PURPLE beret = regular -re.

fr_serrer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe shakes his neighbour's hand warmly: 'SAY, RAY!' (say-RAY).
fr_serrer_verb.why: SAY RAY → serrer = to squeeze, to grip (serrer la main = to shake hands). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_lever_verb.hook: Holding his hand mirror, Monsieur Verbe is sprung up out of his deckchair by a big wooden LEVER (luh-VAY).
fr_lever_verb.why: LEVER → se lever = to get up, to stand up (je me lève à sept heures); lever = to lift, to raise. Reflexive: the mirror; être in compound tenses. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_appuyer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe presses down hard on the apple press: 'APPLE, YAY!' (a-pwee-YAY).
fr_appuyer_verb.why: APPLE YAY → appuyer = to press, to push (appuyer sur le bouton); to lean, to support. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_tirer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe pulls his TEA TRAY along on its little wheels (tee-RAY).
fr_tirer_verb.why: TEA TRAY → tirer = to pull, to draw (tirer la porte, tirer les rideaux). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_trainer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe drags a wooden toy TRAIN behind him on a string (tray-NAY).
fr_trainer_verb.why: TRAIN → traîner = to drag, to pull along; to hang around (traîner une valise). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_accrocher_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe hangs his CROCHET blanket on a big iron hook (a-kro-SHAY).
fr_accrocher_verb.why: CROCHET → accrocher = to hang (on a hook), to hook (accrocher son manteau). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_charger_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe loads a sack onto the donkey cart and cries 'CHARGE!' (shar-ZHAY).
fr_charger_verb.why: CHARGE → charger = to load (charger la voiture); to charge (a battery). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_peser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe weighs A POSY of tulips on the hanging scale (puh-ZAY).
fr_peser_verb.why: POSY → peser = to weigh (peser les tomates; ça pèse lourd). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_interrompre_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe INTERRUPTS the lady gardener at her tulips: 'Excuse me…!' (an-tay-ROMPR).
fr_interrompre_verb.why: INTERRUPT → interrompre = to interrupt (ne m'interromps pas). GOLD beret = irregular (like rompre: il interrompt).

fr_allumer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe switches on the lantern and it ILLUMINATES the lane (a-lu-MAY).
fr_allumer_verb.why: ILLUMINATE → allumer = to light, to switch on (allumer la lumière). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_pendre_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe pegs a toy PANDA up on the washing line (PONdr).
fr_pendre_verb.why: PANDA → pendre = to hang, to hang up (pendre le linge). PURPLE beret = regular -re.

fr_glisser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe slides down the little slide with GLEE (glee-SAY).
fr_glisser_verb.why: GLEE → glisser = to slide, to slip (glisser sur la glace). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_pousser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe PUSHES a wheelbarrow full of tulips.
fr_pousser_verb.why: PUSH → pousser = to push (pousser la porte); to grow (les fleurs poussent). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_presser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe PRESSES oranges for fresh juice (pray-SAY).
fr_presser_verb.why: PRESS → presser = to squeeze, to press (presser un citron); to hurry. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_tourner_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe TURNS the handle of the barrel organ and out comes the music (toor-NAY).
fr_tourner_verb.why: TURN → tourner = to turn (tourner la manivelle, tourner à gauche). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_reposer_verb.hook: Holding his hand mirror, Monsieur Verbe rests in the deckchair in a lazy POSE (ruh-po-ZAY).
fr_reposer_verb.why: POSE → se reposer = to rest (je me repose le dimanche); reposer = to put back down. Reflexive: the mirror; être in compound tenses. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_eteindre_verb.hook: It's lights-out AT TEN: Monsieur Verbe reaches up from his bicycle and puts out the street lamp (ay-TANDR).
fr_eteindre_verb.why: AT TEN → éteindre = to switch off, to put out (éteindre la lumière). GOLD beret = irregular (like peindre: il éteint, éteint).

fr_ouvrir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe opens the gift box: 'OOH, VERY nice!' (oo-VREER).
fr_ouvrir_verb.why: OOH VERY → ouvrir = to open (ouvrir la porte). GOLD beret = irregular (j'ouvre, ouvert).

fr_ramasser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe picks up fallen apples while a woolly RAM nudges him (ra-ma-SAY).
fr_ramasser_verb.why: RAM → ramasser = to pick up, to gather (ramasser des pommes). RED beret = regular -er.
